## Summary

InterviewOS v3.0.0 marks a major milestone: a full visual and architectural overhaul, rebranding the application to **InterviewOS**, introducing the **Executive Charcoal & Warm Amber** design system adhering to the Impeccable craft floor, a dedicated full-screen **Knowledge Bank** hub with cross-interview usage tracking, an inline **Active Context strip**, and dynamic **Role & Persona overrides** per interview.

## What's New

- **Rebrand to InterviewOS:** The application is now InterviewOS, featuring updated app identifiers (`com.interviewos.desktop`), cleaner packaging, and updated release channels.
- **Executive Charcoal & Warm Amber Theme:** A complete design overhaul replacing the previous blue accents with a sleek `#121214` canvas, `#16161a` surfaces, and warm amber (`#f59e0b`) indicators. AI anti-patterns (gradient text, bouncy spring physics, nested cards) have been completely purged in favor of crisp hairline borders and exponential ease-out motion.
- **Dedicated Knowledge Bank Hub:** Replaced the right sidebar drawer with a full-screen Knowledge Bank (`[ 📚 Knowledge Bank ]`). Candidates can manage reusable resumes, technical cheat sheets, and job specifications with instant search, text preview, drag-and-drop ingestion, and cross-interview usage badges (`Used in: Google, Stripe`).
- **Inline Active Context Strip:** Context documents are now seamlessly managed right inside the interview view via an inline strip under the Round Switcher with 1-click detachment (`✕`), an "+ Attach from Knowledge Bank" picker modal, and direct drag-and-drop chat attachment.
- **Per-Interview Candidate Background & AI Persona Overrides:** Added role-specific prompt tuning accessible via the `[ ⚡ Role & Persona ]` header button. Each interview workspace can now inherit global defaults or provide custom candidate background notes and AI persona instructions, dynamically synchronized to the LLM runtime on workspace switch.

## Improvements & Fixes

- **Cross-Interview Document Usage Tracking:** Electron IPC endpoint `knowledge-bank:get-document-usage` tracks document references across all workspaces, alerting users if they attempt to delete a document attached to active interviews.
- **Dynamic LLM Sync:** Overriding persona settings instantly updates `LLMHelper` without requiring an application reload.
- **Craft Floor Verification:** 0 React Doctor errors, 0 TypeScript errors, 100% Impeccable slop detector pass rate, and all unit tests passing.
